map.配方从 2 人份改 6 人份、或小批量改大批量时，所有原料按同一比例缩放。输入原: When changing a recipe from 2 servings to 6, or from small batch to large batch, all ingredients scale by the same ratio. Enter the original amounts and the factor to convert in bulk, avoiding manual errors.
map.配方缩放采用比例换算：每种原料新用量 = 原用量 ×（目标份数 ÷ 原份数），所: Recipe scaling uses ratio conversion: each ingredient's new amount = original amount × (target servings / original servings), all ingredients scale synchronously to keep the ratio. Calculation is done locally in the browser, no data uploaded.
map.原料（每行 名称=数量，单位跟在数字后）: Ingredients (one per line: name=amount, unit after the number)
map.缩放仅改变用量比例，不改变工艺（烘烤温度、时间可能需按模具大小微调，非简单线性）: Scaling only changes the usage ratio, not the process (baking temperature and time may need fine-tuning by mold size, not simple linear).
map.整数个的原料（如鸡蛋 2 个）按比例可能出现 3 个，实际可四舍五入或调整配方总: Integer ingredients (e.g. 2 eggs) may become 3 by ratio; in practice round or adjust the total recipe amount.
map.烘焙对配比敏感，大幅缩放时建议保留关键比例（面粉:液体:酵母）。: Baking is sensitive to ratios; for large scaling keep the key ratios (flour : liquid : yeast).
map.把 2 人份家庭配方改做成 8 人份宴客量，全部原料按同一倍数放大，避免手算比例: Scale a 2-serving home recipe up to an 8-serving party amount, enlarging all ingredients by the same factor, avoiding manual ratio errors.
map.小分量试做确认口味后，放大到量产批次，保持配料比例与质地不变。: After a small-batch trial to confirm taste, scale up to a production batch while keeping ingredient ratios and texture unchanged.
map.已有原料库存有限时，按目标制作份数反推每种配料所需用量。: When existing ingredient stock is limited, back-calculate each ingredient's required amount from the target number of servings.
map.原配方做 4 个：黄油 100g、低筋面粉 200g、糖 80g。目标 10 个: Original recipe makes 4: butter 100g, cake flour 200g, sugar 80g. Target 10, scaling factor = 10 / 4 = 2.5. So butter 250g, flour 500g, sugar 200g; the ratio is exactly the same and the size and taste of the product are unchanged.
map.缩放后烘烤时间要跟着改吗？: Should baking time change after scaling?
map.体积明显变大时中心受热变慢，通常需要延长烘烤时间或略微降低温度，避免外焦内生；变: When volume clearly increases, the center heats slower, so usually extend baking time or slightly lower temperature to avoid a burnt outside with an undercooked inside; if the change is small (±20%), you can basically keep the original time and watch the browning.
map.可以只缩放部分原料吗？: Can I scale only some ingredients?
map.不可以。配方缩放必须所有原料乘以同一倍数，否则面粉、液体、膨松剂比例失衡会改变成: No. Recipe scaling must multiply all ingredients by the same factor; otherwise the ratio of flour, liquid and leavening becomes unbalanced and changes the product's structure and taste. Only when separately adjusting sweetness or flavor is a small change to the proportion of sugar or spices allowed.
